sn35.76:1.1: atha kho āyasmā rādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṃkami …pe…
sn35.76:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.76:1.3: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.76:1.4: yaṃ kho rādha, aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.76:1.5: kiñca rādha, aniccaṃ? cakkhuṃ kho rādha, aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.76:1.6: rūpā aniccā, tatra te chando pahātabbo; cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo;
sn35.76:1.7: cakkhusamphasso anicco, tatra te chando pahātabbo;
sn35.76:1.8: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ. tatra te chando pahātabbo; …pe…
sn35.76:1.10: aniccā, tatra te chando pahātabbo: rasā aniccā, …pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ …pe… jivhāsamphasso anicco …pe… yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
sn35.76:1.11: mano anicco. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.76:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.76:1.16: yaṃ kho rādha aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabboti.
